name: RGB_REGRET
hypothesis: Explicitly penalize H examples whose phase correction increases error relative to the frozen RGB anchor
model: Unchanged PhaseUnitAnchor, 340 features, same R/E hidden states and phase units; no F_TRUE state
regret_boundary: torch.relu derivative zero at zero; initial RGB-preserving output has zero penalty
anchor_reference: emitted_phase(raw_RGB) on the same CPU backend as the new readout
unchanged: H sampler/masses, native AdamW/schedule, batch128, native widths, 2500 updates, no new residual cap
gates: Original 2% per-band and all original comparative/paired gates; 4% remains secondary sensitivity
scope: New supervised H stage on H-trained contexts, not OOF; V exposed development; no GT-based deployment selector
